text_db9040815ed6: Open Updates. Check the displayed web and Android versions. On Android, choose Check for updates. Save open entries and stop GPS. When an update is ready, choose Install update and confirm installation in Android. Automatic checks continue at most every six hours; the login shows Update only for a verified newer APK.
text_e08b899d1df0: Log a stop with type DB InfraGo and reason DB-Digi-Befehl? A current stop receives this reason; otherwise a manual stop starts. End a manual stop with End stop; a GPS stop ends when you move on. Cancel opens only the DB page.
text_f6c7d92f2559: Type DB InfraGo or reason DB-Digi-Befehl is not enabled. Contact your administrator. You can still open the DB page.
text_0ffc6ca8e70a: DB Digi-Bef. opens the existing page https://db.de/dibe in the external browser. On Android, a previously started GPS recording continues in the native service. Points are merged when you return. Confirm a stop only when you are actually stopped. Type DB InfraGo and reason DB-Digi-Befehl are retained when transferring the stop to the journey.
